beats.heading: Understanding a transformation
beats.body: Think in pictures before memorizing the formula.
beats.narration: A useful model starts with an intuitive picture of the transformation and how it moves points in space.

beats.heading: Before and after
beats.body: Track what changed and what stayed fixed.
beats.narration: Compare two possible outcomes and notice which property stays exactly the same.

beats.heading: Shape of a sine wave
beats.body: The curve repeats every full turn.
beats.narration: The sine graph oscillates above and below zero as we increase the input.

beats.heading: A short identity
beats.body: We can connect sine and cosine visually.
beats.narration: The equation gives us a compact way of expressing the connection between two familiar functions.

beats.heading: How to reason
beats.body: Use intuition, derive, and then test.
beats.narration: We first build intuition, then derive a formula, and finally verify it with an example.
